email.name: account.activate
email.subject: Confirm your email address
email.content:
Confirm your email address

Hi {$DATA.first_name|capitalize},

Someone asked to create an account at {$DATA.store_name} with this email address, which we already have from a previous order. Confirm the address to finish setting the account up.

Confirm my email

The link expires in 1 hour.

If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this address into your browser:
{$DATA.activate_link}

If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. No account has been created, and your previous orders can't be seen until the address is confirmed.

Thanks,
{$DATA.store_name}

email.name: account.password_recovery
email.subject: Reset your password
email.content:
Reset your password

Hi {$DATA.first_name|capitalize},

We received a request to reset the password for your {$DATA.store_name} account. Use the button below to choose a new one.

Reset my password

The link expires in 1 hour.

If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this address into your browser:
{$DATA.reset_link}

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email and your password will stay the same.

Thanks,
{$DATA.store_name}

email.name: newsletter.verify_email
email.subject: Confirm your subscription
email.content:
Confirm your subscription

{$DATA.email} was used to subscribe to the {$DATA.store_name} newsletter. Confirm it's yours and we'll add you to the list.

Confirm my subscription

If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this address into your browser:
{$DATA.link}

If you didn't ask to subscribe, you can ignore this email.

Thanks,
{$DATA.store_name}

email.name: newsletter.remove_request

Thanks,
